int save_xstate(struct xsave_struct *fx, u64 mask) {
    int ret = 0;

    asm volatile(
        ".alternative_if_not 0,1\n"
        ".alternative_if_not 1,2\n"
        ".long 0\n"
        "xsave %[fx]\n"
        ".long 1\n"
        "xsaveopt %[fx]\n"
        ".long 2\n"
        "xsaves %[fx]\n"
        ".alternative_else\n"
        "xsave %[fx]\n"
        ".alternative_endif"
        : [fx] "+m"(*fx)
        : "a"(mask), "d"(0)
        : "memory");

    return ret;
}
